meta.notes: M4 weapons-2 head start: the chain (the weapon list is decided). The longest reach and the slowest wind-up of the roadside weapons; a landed hit wraps the target and drags some speed off them (the melee.wrap behaviour and the 'Chain drag' slider). Crude starting numbers, [default]. Live from W-Q (2026-10-02, the pitch deck's "the four unfinished ones go live"). W-T (the pitch deck's #4, 'weapons with verbs'): it YANKS (melee.yank). The hit still wraps and drags, and it pulls the target across your line to the 'Chain yank past you' slider's distance (1.2 m) beyond it, so a rider you yank from his oncoming side comes out in the oncoming lane. knockback.lateralMps now only sets the hit's jolt.
